'''Trevin Berno''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Exchange]] Captain who was active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Eventually, he was killed alongside other Exchange bosses and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] leaders, by an individual in his [[Mandalorian outpost (Jundland Wastes)|outpost]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Encounter" />
